inboxEntryRecovery20261008.kind: Q2 variant D recovery — the arm-A inbox.entry for FOC-132 and FOC-136, reproduced literally from the run record
inboxEntryRecovery20261008.recovered: LITERALLY, from disk — variant A ({issueId, title, scopeSummary}) is NOT needed. The briefs survive as the --prompt-file each arm-B PLAN child was spawned with, and each spawn's pinned-state check `prompt-file-readable` names the path, so the provenance chain is: spawn record -> check -> file bytes.
inboxEntryRecovery20261008.whatIsExcludedAndWhy: ONLY the PINNED-STATE prologue the launcher prepends at spawn is excluded from inbox.entry. That prologue carries repo/worktree/branch/base-revision/run ids — harness chrome that arm A models separately as `repoState.pinned` ({branch, head}), so including it would double-count and would leak run ids into the model prompt. Everything the hand-written kickoff file itself contains is reproduced byte-for-byte, INCLUDING the squad-role framing at its top ('You are the PLAN child ... emit ONE supervisor gate').
inboxEntryRecovery20261008.chromeCaveat: That squad-role framing is meaningless-to-misleading for arm A's plan.intent (it is a graph node, not a squad child). It is kept anyway, and the excerpted-brief variant is the SENSITIVITY line. Reason: criterion C4 says arm A sees what arm B saw; and keeping the extra tokens can only make arm A look worse on both axes, never better — so the whole file is the conservative-direction main number (§4.2 / Q7 rule), exactly as with the stall rule.
inboxEntryRecovery20261008.bodyNotCopiedIntoRepo: The brief bodies are NOT stored in this file or in the repo: they contain a customer host address and other customer context. The record carries the source path + sha256 + byte counts instead, which is what 'ze zrodlem zapisanym w foc-477-runs.json' requires and is enough to prove later that the run input matched byte-for-byte.
inboxEntryRecovery20261008.egress: Both recovered briefs CLEAR the egress screen (0 hits on the exact plan.dor state bytes) — verified 2026-10-08T17:07:57.856Z. Runs 6 and 7 are therefore unblocked on the screen axis as well as the anchor axis.
